title: Kamailio World 2026: Selection Of Speakers
html:
In 2026, Kamailio project celebrates 25 the years of continuous development. Kamailio World Conference 2026 tries be a special edition, giving the chance for developers and users community to meet once again in Berlin, Germany, during May 7-8, 2026.

Only a few days left to submit a presentation proposal and we are ready to announce the first group of selected speakers:

    • Alexandr Dubovikov, Homer SIPCapture Project, Germany
    • Andreas Granig, Sipfront, Austria
    • Daniel-Constantin Mierla, Asipto – Kamailio Project, Germany
    • Dorgham Sisalem, Frafos, Germany
    • Elena-Ramona Modroiu, Technische Universität Berlin, Germany
    • Fred Posner, Lod.com, USA
    • Jan Janak, Columbia University, USA
    • Jiri Kuthan, Iptel.org, Czech Republic
    • Lorenzo Miniero, Meetecho – Janus Gateway, Italy
    • Mack Hendricks, dOpenSource, USA
    • Roman Onic, Kontron Transportation, Austria
    • Sandro Gauci, Enable Security, Germany
    • Victor Seva, Kamailio Project, Spain
    • Wolfgang Kamplicher, Frequentis, Austria

Should you have anything interesting to share about Kamailio or Real Time Communications, consider to submit a proposal via the web form at:

    • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k2026/call-for-speakers/

Looking forward to meeting many of you at Kamailio World 2026!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
